clue.text: Try to catch calendar girls wearing cycling gear

indicators.note: cycling means moving the front letter of the following word round to the back, like a wheel turning
the second item has the first one on it, the way clothes surround a body

blocks.note: the word gear with its first letter moved to the end
the Calendar Girls were members of the Women's Institute, abbreviated WI

explanation.surface: A cyclist in lycra tries to grab a pin-up calendar of ladies.
explanation.walkthrough: Calendar Girls is a British film about Women's Institute members (the WI, a women's club) who posed for a nude charity calendar. EARWIG as a verb means to eavesdrop.
explanation.definitionFit: To earwig is British slang for eavesdropping, listening in secretly in an attempt to overhear private talk.

clue.text: Staggered entries will finally join up again

blocks.note: taken as written
the closing letter of will

explanation.surface: Applications that arrive in batches will eventually be merged together.
explanation.definitionFit: To re-enlist is to sign up for military service a second time, which is joining up once more.

blocks.note: to sit for an artist is to model
to sue is to take legal action

explanation.surface: Someone wraps an artist's model in paper before taking a case to court.
explanation.definitionFit: Tissue paper is the thin wrapping sheet used for covering gifts and delicate goods.

clue.text: Present component of further education

explanation.definitionFit: Being here means being in attendance, as when a register is called and pupils answer.

clue.text: What would enhance the sound of new opera he composed?

blocks.note: N is the standard abbreviation for new
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: An earphone is a small speaker held to the ear, bringing audio closer and clearer to the listener.

clue.text: Doctor gets young man wanting heroin to undergo therapy for addiction

blocks.note: DR is the usual abbreviation for doctor

explanation.definitionFit: To dry out is the idiom for getting clean in rehab, especially by giving up drink or drugs.

clue.text: Authority figure in charge I refuse to accept

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so one word goes inside another

taken as written

clue.text: Pause attempt to shoot after four failures?

definitions.text: attempt to shoot after four failures?

blocks.note: first meaning: have a short rest

blocks.clueFragment: attempt to shoot after four failures?
blocks.note: second meaning: on a film set, the fifth try at filming a scene

explanation.walkthrough: On a film set each attempt at a shot is a numbered take, so after four botched ones the director calls the fifth.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for a brief break, and literally the fifth filmed attempt at one scene.

clue.text: Plug gap at sea

blocks.note: a plug is a piece of publicity, an advert
a rift is a gap or split

explanation.definitionFit: Being at sea figuratively means lost or confused, and adrift carries the same drifting, aimless idea.

clue.text: Jazz singer's first attempts to produce a hit

blocks.note: swing is a style of jazz
opening letter of singer

explanation.definitionFit: In golf, baseball or cricket, swings are the motions of club or bat aimed at striking the ball.

clue.text: What presumably inspired UKIP with right to destroy Britain's sense of well-being?

R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A political jibe that UKIP's motivations, joined by the political right, wrecked Britain's mood.
explanation.walkthrough: UKIP was the UK Independence Party, which campaigned to leave the European Union; EUPHOBIA is a made-up word for fear of the EU.
explanation.definitionFit: Euphoria is an intense feeling of happiness and elation, a heightened state of contentment.

clue.text: Repulsive state's government policies welcomed by America

blocks.note: G is a standard abbreviation for government

explanation.surface: A nasty regime's political programme is embraced by the United States.
explanation.walkthrough: State looks like a country, but here it means a condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Ugliness is the condition of being unpleasant to look at, which is a repulsive state.

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for second

explanation.definitionFit: To obtain is to acquire or come by something, a formal synonym for getting.

taken as written

the central letter of corps
in a down entry, a piece on another is held up by it

clue.text: Dress Armani has shortened for member of royal family

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Fish Spooner says is unable to reproduce

clue.text: Liked friend of Dorothy receiving fine
